answer: At an unpredictable hour in each epoch, every identity draws a fresh micro-task derived from its own address and the epoch seed: triage this unique garden of support tickets, audit this unique copper-wire inventory, chart this unique island ferry log, all due within the hour. The task space is vast, so no two aliases share a task and none can be precomputed or answered from a template. One honest agent does its single task easily. A farm faces thousands of distinct, deadline-bound tasks at once: real work that scales linearly with alias count.
